I need to find RAN5 specs that received the most CRs. The question asks about RAN5 specs - "RAN5" is the working group with primary code "R5" in the inventory. I need specs whose specNumber is in the R5 list, counting CRs via the HAS_CR or MODIFIES relationship.

The issue: identifying "RAN5 specs" requires the R5 inventory list, which is source data and not graph truth. However, the inventory is permitted to interpret source membership. But the question asks for specs receiving CRs — I need to count CRs per spec and filter to R5 specs.

The CR→Spec relationship: rel_MODIFIES ([CR,Spec]), rel_AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC, rel_AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC, etc. "received CRs" most directly maps to CR nodes linked to a Spec. The cleanest is rel_MODIFIES where CR modifies Spec, counting distinct CRs.

However, "churn" / "received the most CRs" counting unit is CRs. But I cannot hardcode the R5 spec list as answer literals — though the inventory is source data permitted for interpreting source membership. The guidance says a source listing is not proof a graph edge/count exists, but I can use it to interpret which specs are RAN5.

I'll filter Spec.specNumber IN the R5 list and count CRs via rel_MODIFIES, top 5.

```json
{"query":"SELECT s.specNumber AS specNumber FROM Spec s JOIN rel_MODIFIES m ON m.dst_id = s.node_id JOIN CR c ON c.node_id = m.src_id WHERE s.specNumber IN ('11.10','11.10-1','11.10-2','11.10-3','11.10dcs','11.40','11.40dcs','34.108','34.114','34.121','34.121-1','34.121-2','34.122','34.123-1','34.123-2','34.123-3','34.171','34.172','34.229-1','34.229-2','34.229-3','34.229-4','34.229-5','34.901','34.902','34.910','34.943','36.508','36.509','36.521-1','36.521-2','36.521-3','36.521-4','36.523-1','36.523-2','36.523-3','36.571-1','36.571-2','36.571-3','36.571-5','36.579-1','36.579-2','36.579-3','36.579-4','36.579-5','36.579-6','36.579-7','36.579-8','36.579-9','36.903','36.904','36.905','36.978','37.544','37.571-1','37.571-2','37.571-3','37.571-4','37.571-5','37.579-1','37.579-2','37.579-4','37.579-5','37.579-6','37.579-7','37.901','37.901-5','37.905','38.508-1','38.508-2','38.509','38.521-1','38.521-2','38.521-3','38.521-4','38.521-5','38.522','38.523-1','38.523-2','38.523-3','38.533','38.551','38.561','38.903','38.905','38.918','51.010-1','51.010-2','51.010-3','51.010-5','51.010-7') GROUP BY s.specNumber ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT c.node_id) DESC LIMIT 5","abstain":false}
```
